issues.explanation: CI deploy/test workflows are unrelated to the entities task and should be a separate change.
Same as above: test-gate workflow is unrelated to the entities task.
Domain writes are done directly in Livewire/controller with no app/Actions/* classes, contrary to conventions requiring one Action per use case.
Same Actions deviation for entity settings writes.
Entity pages require auth+verified but no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware for verified is shown, so update requests may bypass verification.
Settings has GET forbidden tests but no non-owner direct Livewire calls to save/delete/transfer; each action needs an unauthorized-call test.
Role select offers owner option that server always rejects as validation error; hide or disable it for clarity.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:226 direct create, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:330 update / 338-341 delete / 360-384 transfer with no app/Actions/*; otherwise #[Locked] entity, policies, $fillable attributes, docs updated

readability.evidence: app/Models/User.php:575 membershipFor, app/Models/UserRole.php:603 manageable, small mount/action methods, Blade x-form-field/x-button consistent; no dead code

requirements.evidence: database/migrations/* entities_slug_unique + entity_memberships_entity_user_unique + entity_memberships_one_owner with owner_seq storedAs; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php + EntityMembershipPolicy.php match spec; EntityController.php:122 pick session+audit+redirect; Dashboard/Members/Settings actions + routes/web.php:1234-1238 + lang/ui.php keys + docs/database-schema.md

scope.evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml:1 and .github/workflows/tests.yml:1 add CI deploy unrelated to entities; remainder (models, policies, Livewire, routes, langs, tests, docs, CHANGELOG) serves task

security.evidence: Gate::authorize view in pick, $this->authorize view/assignRole/delete/manageSettings everywhere, entity-id tamper abort 403 (Members.php:238-240,260-262), transfer scoped to entity admin non-self with lockForUpdate, {{ }} escaping; gap: no persistent verified middleware

simplicity.evidence: Lean Eloquent reuse (memberships(), membershipFor, UserRole::manageable), no service layers or duplication; minimal migrations/policies/components

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityModelTest, EntityPolicyTest, EntityPickTest, EntityDashboardTest, EntityMembersTest (tampered id, employee 403, owner/last-manager 403), EntitySettingsTest (slug unique, locked swap, foreign admin, vanished owner); missing Settings action-level non-owner tests

review.summary: Implements the full entities/memberships model, policies, picker, dashboard, members and owner-only settings with strong authorization and thorough tests. Needs changes before merging: remove unrelated CI workflows, route domain writes through app/Actions/*, and cover missing authorization/persistence cases.
